answer_1.quote: Speech-to-Speech translation seeks to translate speech segments from one language into another.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate BLASER on these datasets on the popular benchmark of . We also benchmark several strong ASR-based metrics, e.g., ASR-SENTBLEU (i.e., sentence-level ASR-BLEU ) and ASR-COMET (i.e., applying COMET  on ASR outputs).

answer_4.quote: We do not use crowd workers as human annotators and instead we use a vendor-managed pool of well-trained and qualified bilingual annotators who pass a qualification test for their language skills.
answer_4.guideline: Your task is to assess: (1) if audio1 is coherent; (2) if audio2 is coherent; and (3) how well the pair of audios correspond to each other on a scale from 1-5. When rating semantic similarity, please ignore minor typos, grammatical errors, and pronunciation errors if they do not affect your understanding of the audio segments.
